identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed grading framework remains identifiable independently of people, positions, assignments and compensation while its level semantics evolve through immutable releases.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Any change to axes, levels, ordering, applicability or crosswalk semantics creates a successor scheme version.

references.purpose: Moderation evidence evaluated against a pinned scheme version

GradeCrosswalk.ownerPolicy: an authorized scheme or third-party mapping authority; owner need not equal source scheme

invariants: GradeLevel identity is local to exactly one scheme version and track or axis; it is not a root.
A single-ladder scheme uses the reserved track key default.
A dual-track ladder is one scheme with multiple tracks, not multiple schemes.
A levelRef must resolve inside the cited scheme version and its trackOrAxisKey must agree with that level.
Labels and ordinals never prove cross-scheme equivalence.
Frozen or effective scheme versions are immutable.
Only frozen or effective scheme versions are assignment and RoleProfile expectation targets.
Relabeling, reordering or adding levels creates a successor version.
Historical assignments and profiles retain their cited version unless an explicit successor decision is recorded.
Crosswalk identity includes an authorized owner that may differ from either scheme.
Crosswalks are directed, source-and-target-version-pinned, purpose-pinned and semantic-loss declaring.
Crosswalk purpose is one allowedCrosswalkPurposes value; pay, access and pay-eligibility-hint are forbidden.
Each mapped row pins target levels, strength and row-level semantic loss.
Unmappable is explicit with a reason; neighbor ordinals are never coerced.
Many-to-one and one-to-many mappings declare loss.
Crosswalk approval creates no GradeAssignment and changes no pay or access.
Crosswalk effectiveFrom cannot precede its approval and crosswalks never alter prior as-of results.
Retirement preserves historical resolution.
Scheme changes mutate no person, employment, position, GradeAssignment, compensation or access master.
No identifier is allocated without registry reservation.
holds: Registry allocation is pending; no identifier is guessed.

relationPolicy: Every external relation is provisional until reciprocal registry approval.

digestPolicy.canonicalization: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace

datetimePolicy: RFC 3339 with explicit offset; effective time and recorded knowledge time are distinct.
